Sign up WATCH LIVE: 2026 World Figure Skating Championships - Pairs Free Skate Close Venezuela qualifies for LA28 Olympic baseball tournament at World Baseball Classic By Nick Zaccardi, By Nick Zaccardi Published March 15, 2026 06:10 AM Facebook Twitter Email Venezuela qualified to make its Olympic baseball debut by reaching the World Baseball Classic semifinals.Venezuela earned the last 2028 Olympic spot for a North or South American nation by beating Japan 8-5 to reach a Monday semifinal against Italy.The World Baseball Classic marks the first Olympic qualifier across all of the 51 sports contested at LA28.Half of the six-team Olympic baseball field is now set: the U.S., which qualified automatically as host nation, plus the Dominican Republic (the U.S.’ opponent in Sunday’s semifinal) and Venezuela.The rest of the LA28 field will be determined at the November 2027 Premier12 tournament (one spot for Asia, one for Europe/Oceania) and a final qualifier no later than March 2028 (that will not include teams from the Americas). 2026 World Figure Skating Championships: How to watch, schedule, entry listsThe World Figure Skating Championships air live on NBC Sports and Peacock.Discover Cooper Lutkenhaus becomes the youngest individual track and field world championCooper Lutkenhaus won the 800m at the World Indoor Track and Field Championships while on spring break from high school.DiscoverHealth Today Daily9 in 10 Declining Memory Cases Linked To A Common Habit.
